## Parameters

```{r}
###
### SOIL PARAMETERS
###

# Area-based max uptake (kg N m^-2 year^-1) — from hydroponic experiments
u_Amax <- 0.08

# Effective soil diffusion coefficient (m^2 year^-1)
D_default <- 1e-3

# Biochemical half-saturation constant (kg N m^-3)
k_15 <- 0.5

depth <- 0.5

###
### ROOT PARAMETERS
###

# ECM hyphal traits
myco_diameter <- 1e-5   # m
myco_density  <- 330    # kg m^-3

# Mycorrhizal turnover rate (year^-1)
T_m <- 2

# Fraction of roots colonised by ECM
mycorrhized <- 0.9

# Root architecture defaults
n <- 2.75e6
l <- 1.5

C_r <- 2
A_c <- C_r^2 * pi

###
### EXTRA PARAMETERS
###

k_9  <- 0.01
k_8  <- 2.7

# Soil volume scaling
k_13 <- 5
k_14 <- 0.7

traits <- list(
  k_0 = 0.5,
  k_1 = 0.25,
  k_2 = 0.15,
  k_3 = 0.02,
  k_4 = 350,
  k_5 = 150,
  k_6 = 3,
  k_7 = 3,
  k_8 = k_8,
  k_9 = k_9
)

# Fixed plot parameters
B_cr_fixed       <- 0
rho_cr_fixed     <- 500
crown_area_fixed <- pi * C_r^2
```

## Equations

```{r}
############################################################
## ROOT ARCHITECTURE FUNCTIONS
############################################################

# Eq. diameter: d(l) = k_1 / l^k_0
root_diameter <- function(root_length, traits) {
  traits$k_1 / (root_length ^ traits$k_0)
}

# Eq. cortex proportion: PRD(l) = (k_2 + k_3/d(l))^2
root_cortex_proportion <- function(root_length, traits) {
  d <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  (traits$k_2 + traits$k_3 / d)^2
}

# Eq. density: rho(l) = k_4 * PRD(l) + k_5
root_density <- function(root_length, traits) {
  PRD <- root_cortex_proportion(root_length, traits)
  traits$k_4 * PRD + traits$k_5
}

# Eq. age: a(l) = k_6 * (1 - exp(-k_7 * d(l)))
root_age <- function(root_length, traits) {
  d <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  traits$k_6 * (1 - exp(-traits$k_7 * d))
}

# Eq. biomass
root_biomass_per_crown_area <- function(root_length, root_no, traits) {
  d_m <- root_diameter(root_length, traits) / 1000
  rho <- root_density(root_length, traits)
  l_m <- root_length / 1000
  rho * (d_m / 2)^2 * l_m * pi * root_no
}

root_mass <- function(root_length, root_no, crown_area, traits) {
  2 * root_biomass_per_crown_area(root_length, root_no, traits) * crown_area
}

############################################################
## ORGAN-SPECIFIC u_Bmax
## u_Bmax_i = u_Amax * 4 / (rho_i * d_i)
## Derived from surface-area-to-biomass ratio of a cylinder
############################################################

u_Bmax_organ <- function(u_Amax, rho, d_m) {
  u_Amax * 4 / (rho * d_m)
}

############################################################
## DEPLETION RADIUS
## Eq. r_d: r_d = D * (N_s + k_15) / u_Amax
############################################################

depletion_radius <- function(N_s, D, u_Amax) {
  D * N_s / u_Amax
}

############################################################
## EXPLORATION EFFICIENCY
## Annulus-corrected: e_i = 4*(r_d^2 + r_d*d_i) / (rho_i * d_i^2)
############################################################

e_u_root <- function(N_s, root_length, D, u_Amax, k_15, traits) {
  d_m <- root_diameter(root_length, traits) / 2000   # radius in m
  rho <- root_density(root_length, traits)
  r_d <- depletion_radius(N_s, D, u_Amax)
  4 * r_d^2 / (rho * d_m^2)
}

e_u_myco <- function(N_s, D, u_Amax, k_15, myco_diameter, myco_density) {
  r_d <- depletion_radius(N_s, D, u_Amax)
  4 * r_d^2 / (myco_density * (myco_diameter / 2)^2)
}

############################################################
## SOIL VOLUME
############################################################

soil_volume <- function(C_r, q, k_13) {
  (2 / 3) * pi * (k_13 * C_r)^2 * q
}

free_soil_volume <- function(C_r, q, k_13, k_14,
                              B_fr, rho_fr,
                              B_m,  rho_m,
                              B_cr, rho_cr) {
  V_soil <- soil_volume(C_r, q, k_13)
  k_14 * V_soil - B_fr / rho_fr - B_m / rho_m - B_cr / rho_cr
}

############################################################
## CROWDING SATURATION
############################################################

S_crowding <- function(B_fr, B_m, B_cr,
                       root_length,
                       myco_diameter, myco_density,
                       rho_cr,
                       D, N_s, u_Amax, k_15,
                       C_r, q, k_13, k_14,
                       traits) {

  rho_fr <- root_density(root_length, traits)
  d_fr_m <- root_diameter(root_length, traits) / 2000

  r_d <- depletion_radius(N_s, D, u_Amax)

  e_fr <- 4 * r_d^2 / (rho_fr       * d_fr_m^2)
  e_m  <- 4 * r_d^2 / (myco_density * (myco_diameter/2)^2)

  V_explored <- B_fr * e_fr + B_m * e_m

  V_free <- free_soil_volume(C_r, q, k_13, k_14,
                              B_fr, rho_fr,
                              B_m,  myco_density,
                              B_cr, rho_cr)

  if (V_explored > V_free) V_free / V_explored else 1.0
}

############################################################
## SINGLE ORGAN UPTAKE
## Eq. Uc: U_i = B_i * u_Bmax_i * S * N_s / (N_s + k_15)
############################################################

uptake_organ <- function(B_i, u_Bmax_i, S, N_s, k_15) {
  B_i * u_Bmax_i * S * (N_s / (N_s + k_15))
}

root_surface_area <- function(root_length, root_no, traits) {

  d_m <- root_diameter(root_length, traits) / 1000
  L_m <- root_length / 1000

  pi * d_m * L_m * root_no
}

myco_surface_area <- function(B_m, myco_diameter, myco_density) {
  
  # convert biomass → length
  L_total <- B_m / (myco_density * pi * (myco_diameter / 2)^2)

  pi * myco_diameter * L_total
}

uptake_organ_SA <- function(SA_i, u_Amax, S, N_s, k_15) {
  SA_i * u_Amax * S * (N_s / (N_s + k_15))
}

############################################################
## UPTAKE MODIFIERS
############################################################

uptake_age_modifier <- function(root_length, traits) {
  age <- root_age(root_length, traits)
  1 / (1 + exp(age - traits$k_8))
}

nitrogen_gate <- function(root_no, root_length, traits) {
  d  <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  SA <- root_no * pi * d * root_length
  SA / (SA + traits$k_9)
}

############################################################
## WHOLE-PLANT UPTAKE
## Eq. U_a: U_a = a_u * [(1-m)*U_fr + m*g(n,l)*T_m*max(0,N_m)]
############################################################

plant_uptake <- function(N_s, N_m,
                         crown_area, root_length, root_no,
                         B_m, B_cr, rho_cr,
                         traits,
                         mycorrhized,
                         T_m,
                         myco_diameter, myco_density,
                         C_r, q = 0.5, k_13 = 2, k_14 = 0.5,
                         u_Amax, D, k_15) {

  B_fr  <- root_mass(root_length, root_no, crown_area, traits)
  rho_fr <- root_density(root_length, traits)

  # Surface areas — used directly in uptake (no biomass→u_Bmax conversion)
  SA_fr <- root_surface_area(root_length, root_no, traits) * crown_area
  SA_m  <- myco_surface_area(B_m, myco_diameter, myco_density)

  S <- S_crowding(
    B_fr = B_fr, B_m = B_m, B_cr = B_cr,
    root_length = root_length,
    myco_diameter = myco_diameter, myco_density = myco_density,
    rho_cr = rho_cr,
    D = D, N_s = N_s, u_Amax = u_Amax, k_15 = k_15,
    C_r = C_r, q = q, k_13 = k_13, k_14 = k_14,
    traits = traits
  )

  U_fr <- uptake_organ_SA(SA_fr, u_Amax, S, N_s, k_15)
  U_m  <- uptake_organ_SA(SA_m,  u_Amax, S, N_s, k_15)

  a_u <- uptake_age_modifier(root_length, traits)
  g   <- nitrogen_gate(root_no, root_length, traits)

  ECM_transfer <- mycorrhized * g * T_m * max(0, N_m)
  U_a <- a_u * ((1 - mycorrhized) * U_fr + ECM_transfer)

  return(list(
    N_total      = U_a,
    U_fr         = U_fr,
    U_m          = U_m,
    SA_fr        = SA_fr,
    SA_m         = SA_m,
    ECM_transfer = ECM_transfer,
    S            = S,
    a_u          = a_u,
    g            = g,
    B_fr         = B_fr
  ))
}
```

## e_u plots

```{r}
# ===============================================================
# Exploration efficiency plots
# ===============================================================

N_s_vals  <- seq(0.01, 2, length.out = 200)
D_vals    <- 10^seq(-1.5, -4, length.out = 5)

root_d_m <- root_diameter(l, traits) / 1000
root_rho <- root_density(l, traits)

cb_palette <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#0072B2", "#D55E00")

sci_label <- function(x) {
  exponent <- floor(log10(x))
  base     <- round(x / 10^exponent, 2)
  if (base == 1) {
    parse(text = sprintf("10^%d", exponent))
  } else {
    parse(text = sprintf("%g ~ '×' ~ 10^%d", base, exponent))
  }
}

D_levels <- sort(unique(D_vals))
D_labels <- sapply(D_levels, sci_label)

df_eu <- expand_grid(N_s = N_s_vals, D = D_vals) %>%
  mutate(
    r_d   = mapply(function(ns, d) depletion_radius(ns, d, u_Amax), N_s, D),
    e_r   = 4 * r_d^2 / (root_rho    * (root_d_m / 2)^2),
    e_m   = 4 * r_d^2 / (myco_density * (myco_diameter / 2)^2),
    ratio = e_m / e_r,
    D     = factor(D, levels = D_levels)
  )

scale_D <- scale_colour_manual(
  values = cb_palette,
  labels = D_labels,
  name   = expression(D~"(m"^2~"yr"^{-1}*")")
)

theme_pub <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text       = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "right")

p_root <- ggplot(df_eu, aes(N_s, e_r, colour = D)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) + scale_D +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::scientific) +
  labs(title = "Root exploration efficiency",
       x = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"),
       y = expression(e[fr]~"(m"^3~"kg"^{-1}*")")) +
  theme_pub

p_myco <- ggplot(df_eu, aes(N_s, e_m, colour = D)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) + scale_D +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::scientific) +
  labs(title = "Mycorrhizal exploration efficiency",
       x = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"),
       y = expression(e[m]~"(m"^3~"kg"^{-1}*")")) +
  theme_pub

p_rd <- ggplot(df_eu, aes(N_s, r_d, colour = D)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) + scale_D +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::scientific) +
  labs(title = "Depletion radius",
       x = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"),
       y = expression(r[d]~"(m)")) +
  theme_pub

p_ratio <- ggplot(df_eu, aes(N_s, ratio, colour = D)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) + scale_D +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title = "Relative exploration advantage",
       x = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"),
       y = expression(e[m] / e[fr])) +
  theme_pub

(p_root | p_myco) / (p_rd | p_ratio) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## Plots: Crowding Saturation S

```{r}
n_vals     <- seq(1e1, 1e7, length.out = 20)
N_s_vals   <- seq(0.1, 2.0, length.out = 10)
D_vals     <- 10^seq(-1.5, -4, length.out = 5)
u_max_vals <- c(0.44, 0.88, 1.22)/10

df_n_base <- tibble(n = n_vals, l = 1.5) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    B_fr      = root_mass(l, n, crown_area_fixed, traits),
    SA_fr     = root_surface_area(l, n, traits) * crown_area_fixed,
    root_d_mm = root_diameter(l, traits),
    rho_fr    = root_density(l, traits)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_n <- df_n_base %>%
  crossing(D = D_vals, N_s = N_s_vals, u_max = u_max_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    S = S_crowding(
      B_fr = B_fr, B_m = 0, B_cr = B_cr_fixed,
      root_length = l,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter, myco_density = myco_density,
      rho_cr = rho_cr_fixed,
      D = D, N_s = N_s, u_Amax = u_max, k_15 = k_15,
      C_r = C_r, q = depth, k_13 = k_13, k_14 = k_14,
      traits = traits
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_n_myco <- df_n_base %>%
  crossing(D = D_vals, N_s = N_s_vals, u_max = u_max_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    S = S_crowding(
      B_fr = B_fr, B_m = B_fr, B_cr = B_cr_fixed,
      root_length = l,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter, myco_density = myco_density,
      rho_cr = rho_cr_fixed,
      D = D, N_s = N_s, u_Amax = u_max, k_15 = k_15,
      C_r = C_r, q = depth, k_13 = k_13, k_14 = k_14,
      traits = traits
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_combined_n <- bind_rows(
  df_n      %>% mutate(myco = "no myco"),
  df_n_myco %>% mutate(myco = "myco")
) %>%
  mutate(r_d = mapply(function(ns, d, u) depletion_radius(ns, d, u),
                      N_s, D, u_max))

p_S_rd_Ns <- ggplot(df_combined_n,
                    aes(x = r_d, y = S, color = factor(round(N_s, 2)), shape = myco)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("no myco" = 16, "myco" = 4)) +
  labs(title = "Crowding Saturation vs r_d",
       x = expression(r[d]~"(m)"), y = "S",
       color = expression(N[s]), shape = "Mycorrhiza") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)

p_S_rd_D <- ggplot(df_combined_n,
                   aes(x = r_d, y = S, color = factor(D), shape = myco)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("no myco" = 16, "myco" = 4)) +
  labs(title = "Soil diffusion effect",
       x = expression(r[d]~"(m)"), y = "S", color = "D") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)

p_S_rd_umax <- ggplot(df_combined_n,
                      aes(x = r_d, y = S, color = factor(u_max), shape = myco)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("no myco" = 16, "myco" = 4)) +
  labs(title = "Maximum uptake effect",
       x = expression(r[d]~"(m)"), y = "S", color = expression(u[Amax])) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)

p_S_rd_myco <- ggplot(df_combined_n,
                      aes(x = r_d, y = S, color = myco, shape = myco)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("no myco" = 16, "myco" = 4)) +
  labs(title = "Mycorrhizal Effect",
       x = expression(r[d]~"(m)"), y = "S",
       color = "Mycorrhiza", shape = "Mycorrhiza") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)

grid.arrange(p_S_rd_Ns, p_S_rd_D, p_S_rd_umax, p_S_rd_myco, ncol = 2)

k14_vals <- seq(0.1, 1, length.out = 10)

df_k14 <- df_n_base %>%
  crossing(k14 = k14_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    S = S_crowding(
      B_fr = B_fr, B_m = B_fr, B_cr = B_cr_fixed,
      root_length = l,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter, myco_density = myco_density,
      rho_cr = rho_cr_fixed,
      D = 1e-3, N_s = 1.5, u_Amax = u_Amax, k_15 = k_15,
      C_r = C_r, q = depth, k_13 = k_13, k_14 = k14,
      traits = traits
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(df_k14, aes(x = B_fr, y = S, color = factor(k14))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Crowding Saturation Sensitivity to k_14 (porosity)",
       x = "Fine root biomass (kg)", y = "S",
       color = expression(k[14])) +
```

## Root Uptake (Eq. Uc)

```{r}
# ===============================================================
# Root and mycorrhizal uptake: publication plots
# ===============================================================

N_s_vals      <- seq(0.01, 1.0, length.out = 200)
D_vals        <- c(1e-5, 1e-4)
u_max_fixed   <- 0.88/10
N_s_highlight <- c(0.2, 0.4)

cb_two   <- c("1e-05" = "#E69F00", "1e-04" = "#0072B2")
D_labels <- c("1e-05" = expression(10^{-4}), "1e-04" = expression(10^{-3}))

df_basis <- df_n_base

B_highlight  <- c(df_basis$B_fr[7],  max(df_basis$B_fr))
SA_highlight <- c(df_basis$SA_fr[7], max(df_basis$SA_fr))

theme_pub <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
        strip.background  = element_blank(),
        legend.position   = "right",
        legend.text       = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.title      = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.size   = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.y  = unit(0.2, "cm"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# ROOT UPTAKE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

highlight_df <- tibble(B_fr = B_highlight, SA_fr = SA_highlight)

df_root_Ns <- crossing(
    highlight_df,
    myco  = c("no myco", "myco"),
    N_s   = N_s_vals,
    D     = D_vals
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    B_m_use = ifelse(myco == "myco", 1.0, 0),
    S = S_crowding(
      B_fr = B_fr, B_m = B_m_use, B_cr = B_cr_fixed,
      root_length = l,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter, myco_density = myco_density,
      rho_cr = rho_cr_fixed,
      D = D, N_s = N_s, u_Amax = u_max_fixed, k_15 = k_15,
      C_r = C_r, q = depth, k_13 = k_13, k_14 = k_14,
      traits = traits
    ),
    U_fr    = uptake_organ_SA(SA_fr, u_max_fixed, S, N_s, k_15),
    D_label = factor(as.character(D), levels = c("1e-05", "1e-04")),
    B_label = factor(ifelse(B_fr == min(B_highlight), "low", "high"),
                     levels = c("low", "high"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(ifelse(myco == "no myco",
                               "(a.i) Without ECM", "(a.ii) With ECM"),
                        levels = c("(a.i) Without ECM", "(a.ii) With ECM")))

p_root_Ns <- ggplot(df_root_Ns,
       aes(x = N_s, y = U_fr, colour = D_label, linetype = B_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cb_two, labels = D_labels,
                      name = expression(D~"(m"^2~"yr"^{-1}*")")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("low" = 3, "high" = 1),
                        name = expression(B[fr])) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::scientific) +
  labs(x = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"),
       y = expression(U[fr]~"(kg N yr"^{-1}*")")) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10))

df_root_B <- df_basis %>%
  crossing(
    myco = c("no myco", "myco"),
    N_s  = N_s_highlight,
    D    = D_vals
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    B_m_use = ifelse(myco == "myco", 1.0, 0),
    S = S_crowding(
      B_fr = B_fr, B_m = B_m_use, B_cr = B_cr_fixed,
      root_length = l,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter, myco_density = myco_density,
      rho_cr = rho_cr_fixed,
      D = D, N_s = N_s, u_Amax = u_max_fixed, k_15 = k_15,
      C_r = C_r, q = depth, k_13 = k_13, k_14 = k_14,
      traits = traits
    ),
    U_fr    = uptake_organ_SA(SA_fr, u_max_fixed, S, N_s, k_15),
    D_label = factor(as.character(D), levels = c("1e-05", "1e-04")),
    N_label = factor(as.character(N_s), levels = c("0.2", "0.4"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(ifelse(myco == "no myco",
                               "(b.i) Without ECM", "(b.ii) With ECM"),
                        levels = c("(b.i) Without ECM", "(b.ii) With ECM")))

p_root_B <- ggplot(df_root_B,
       aes(x = B_fr, y = U_fr, colour = D_label, linetype = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cb_two, labels = D_labels,
                      name = expression(D~"(m"^2~"yr"^{-1}*")")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("0.2" = 3, "0.4" = 1),
                        labels = c("0.2" = expression(N[s] == 0.2),
                                   "0.4" = expression(N[s] == 0.4)),
                        name = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::scientific) +
  labs(x = expression(B[fr]~"(kg)"),
       y = expression(U[fr]~"(kg N yr"^{-1}*")")) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# MYCORRHIZAL UPTAKE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

df_myco_Ns <- crossing(
    B_m   = B_highlight,
    root  = c("no root", "root"),
    N_s   = N_s_vals,
    D     = D_vals
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    B_fr_use = ifelse(root == "root", 1.0, 0),
    SA_m  = myco_surface_area(B_m, myco_diameter, myco_density),
    S = S_crowding(
      B_fr = B_fr_use, B_m = B_m, B_cr = B_cr_fixed,
      root_length = l,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter, myco_density = myco_density,
      rho_cr = rho_cr_fixed,
      D = D, N_s = N_s, u_Amax = u_max_fixed, k_15 = k_15,
      C_r = C_r, q = depth, k_13 = k_13, k_14 = k_14,
      traits = traits
    ),
    U_m     = uptake_organ_SA(SA_m, u_max_fixed, S, N_s, k_15),
    D_label = factor(as.character(D), levels = c("1e-05", "1e-04")),
    B_label = factor(ifelse(B_m == min(B_highlight), "low", "high"),
                     levels = c("low", "high"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(ifelse(root == "no root",
                               "(c.i) Without roots", "(c.ii) With roots"),
                        levels = c("(c.i) Without roots", "(c.ii) With roots")))

p_myco_Ns <- ggplot(df_myco_Ns,
       aes(x = N_s, y = U_m, colour = D_label, linetype = B_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cb_two, labels = D_labels,
                      name = expression(D~"(m"^2~"yr"^{-1}*")")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("low" = 3, "high" = 1),
                        name = expression(B[m])) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::scientific) +
  labs(x = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"),
       y = expression(U[m]~"(kg N yr"^{-1}*")")) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10))

df_myco_B <- df_basis %>%
  crossing(
    root = c("no root", "root"),
    N_s  = N_s_highlight,
    D    = D_vals
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    B_fr_use = ifelse(root == "root", 1.0, 0),
    SA_m  = myco_surface_area(B_fr, myco_diameter, myco_density),
    S = S_crowding(
      B_fr = B_fr_use, B_m = B_fr, B_cr = B_cr_fixed,
      root_length = l,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter, myco_density = myco_density,
      rho_cr = rho_cr_fixed,
      D = D, N_s = N_s, u_Amax = u_max_fixed, k_15 = k_15,
      C_r = C_r, q = depth, k_13 = k_13, k_14 = k_14,
      traits = traits
    ),
    U_m     = uptake_organ_SA(SA_m, u_max_fixed, S, N_s, k_15),
    D_label = factor(as.character(D), levels = c("1e-05", "1e-04")),
    N_label = factor(as.character(N_s), levels = c("0.2", "0.4"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(ifelse(root == "no root",
                               "(d.i) Without roots", "(d.ii) With roots"),
                        levels = c("(d.i) Without roots", "(d.ii) With roots")))

p_myco_B <- ggplot(df_myco_B,
       aes(x = B_fr, y = U_m, colour = D_label, linetype = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cb_two, labels = D_labels,
                      name = expression(D~"(m"^2~"yr"^{-1}*")")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("0.2" = 3, "0.4" = 1),
                        labels = c("0.2" = expression(N[s] == 0.2),
                                   "0.4" = expression(N[s] == 0.4)),
                        name = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::scientific) +
  labs(x = expression(B[m]~"(kg)"),
       y = expression(U[m]~"(kg N yr"^{-1}*")")) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10))

(p_root_Ns + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) signif(x, 2)) | p_root_B) / (p_myco_Ns + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) signif(x, 2)) | p_myco_B) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## Sensitivity Analysis: depth, k\_15, k\_13, k\_14

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Fixed operating point for sensitivity analysis
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

N_s_fixed  <- 1.0
N_m_fixed  <- 0.1
B_m_fixed  <- 0.5

run_uptake <- function(depth_val, k15_val, k13_val, k14_val) {
  plant_uptake(
    N_s           = N_s_fixed,
    N_m           = N_m_fixed,
    crown_area    = crown_area_fixed,
    root_length   = l,
    root_no       = n,
    B_m           = B_m_fixed,
    B_cr          = B_cr_fixed,
    rho_cr        = rho_cr_fixed,
    traits        = traits,
    mycorrhized   = mycorrhized,
    T_m           = T_m,
    myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
    myco_density  = myco_density,
    C_r           = C_r,
    q             = depth_val,
    k_13          = k13_val,
    k_14          = k14_val,
    u_Amax        = u_Amax,
    D             = D_default,
    k_15          = k15_val
  )$N_total
}

baseline_uptake <- run_uptake(depth, k_15, k_13, k_14)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameter sweeps
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

n_pts <- 60

param_ranges <- list(
  depth = seq(0.05, 2.0,  length.out = n_pts),
  k_15  = seq(0.05, 3.0,  length.out = n_pts),
  k_13  = seq(0.5,  20.0, length.out = n_pts),
  k_14  = seq(0.05, 0.95, length.out = n_pts)
)

df_sa <- bind_rows(
  tibble(param = "depth", value = param_ranges$depth,
         uptake = sapply(param_ranges$depth, \(v) run_uptake(v, k_15, k_13, k_14))),
  tibble(param = "k_15", value = param_ranges$k_15,
         uptake = sapply(param_ranges$k_15, \(v) run_uptake(depth, v, k_13, k_14))),
  tibble(param = "k_13", value = param_ranges$k_13,
         uptake = sapply(param_ranges$k_13, \(v) run_uptake(depth, k_15, v, k_14))),
  tibble(param = "k_14", value = param_ranges$k_14,
         uptake = sapply(param_ranges$k_14, \(v) run_uptake(depth, k_15, k_13, v)))
) %>%
  mutate(param = factor(param, levels = c("depth", "k_15", "k_13", "k_14")))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Sensitivity index
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

eps <- 0.01

si_df <- tibble(
  param = c("depth", "k_15", "k_13", "k_14"),
  default_val = c(depth, k_15, k_13, k_14),
  SI = c(
    (run_uptake(depth*(1+eps), k_15, k_13, k_14) -
     run_uptake(depth*(1-eps), k_15, k_13, k_14)) / (2*eps*baseline_uptake),
    (run_uptake(depth, k_15*(1+eps), k_13, k_14) -
     run_uptake(depth, k_15*(1-eps), k_13, k_14)) / (2*eps*baseline_uptake),
    (run_uptake(depth, k_15, k_13*(1+eps), k_14) -
     run_uptake(depth, k_15, k_13*(1-eps), k_14)) / (2*eps*baseline_uptake),
    (run_uptake(depth, k_15, k_13, k_14*(1+eps)) -
     run_uptake(depth, k_15, k_13, k_14*(1-eps))) / (2*eps*baseline_uptake)
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Spider plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

df_spider <- df_sa %>%
  left_join(
    tibble(
      param = c("depth", "k_15", "k_13", "k_14"),
      default_val = c(depth, k_15, k_13, k_14)
    ),
    by = "param"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_param  = value / default_val,
    rel_uptake = uptake / baseline_uptake
  )

cb_sa <- c(depth = "#E69F00", k_15 = "#56B4E9", k_13 = "#009E73", k_14 = "#D55E00")

p_spider <- ggplot(df_spider, aes(rel_param, rel_uptake, colour = param)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cb_sa) +
  labs(
    title = "Sensitivity spider plot",
    x = "Relative parameter value (× baseline)",
    y = "Relative uptake (× baseline)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Tornado plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

p_tornado <- ggplot(si_df, aes(x = param, y = SI, fill = param)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cb_sa) +
  labs(
    title = "Normalised sensitivity index",
    x = NULL,
    y = "SI"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Sweep panels
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

strip_labs <- c(
  depth = "Depth (m)",
  k_15  = "k15 (half-saturation, kg N m^-3)",
  k_13  = "k13 (soil radius scale)",
  k_14  = "k14 (porosity)"
)

baseline_vlines <- tibble(
  param = c("depth", "k_15", "k_13", "k_14"),
  xint  = c(depth, k_15, k_13, k_14)
)

p_sweeps <- ggplot(df_sa, aes(value, uptake, colour = param)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(data = baseline_vlines, aes(xintercept = xint),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~param, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(param = strip_labs)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cb_sa) +
  labs(
    title = "Parameter sweeps",
    x = "Parameter value",
    y = "N uptake (kg N yr⁻¹)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

p_sweeps / (p_spider | p_tornado)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

eps <- 1e-4

# nitrogen gradient
N_vals <- seq(0.01, 2, length.out = 80)

params <- c("depth", "k_15", "k_13", "k_14", "u_Amax")

components <- c("U_root", "U_myco")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Core simulation wrapper (fully explicit arguments)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_U <- function(N, depth, k_15, k_13, k_14, u_Amax) {

  out <- plant_uptake(
    N_s = N,
    N_m = N_m_fixed,
    crown_area = crown_area_fixed,
    root_length = l,
    root_no = n,
    B_m = B_m_fixed,
    B_cr = B_cr_fixed,
    rho_cr = rho_cr_fixed,
    traits = traits,
    mycorrhized = mycorrhized,
    T_m = T_m,
    myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
    myco_density = myco_density,
    C_r = C_r,
    q = depth,
    k_13 = k_13,
    k_14 = k_14,
    u_Amax = u_Amax,
    D = D_default,
    k_15 = k_15
  )

  c(
    U_total = out$N_total,
    U_root  = out$U_fr,
    U_myco  = out$U_m
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Elasticity function (robust + safe in dplyr)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
elasticity <- function(N, param, component,
                       depth, k_15, k_13, k_14, u_Amax) {

  component <- as.character(component)

  base <- run_U(N, depth, k_15, k_13, k_14, u_Amax)[component]

  pert <- switch(param,

    depth = run_U(N, depth * (1 + eps), k_15, k_13, k_14, u_Amax)[component],

    k_15  = run_U(N, depth, k_15 * (1 + eps), k_13, k_14, u_Amax)[component],

    k_13  = run_U(N, depth, k_15, k_13 * (1 + eps), k_14, u_Amax)[component],

    k_14  = run_U(N, depth, k_15, k_13, k_14 * (1 + eps), u_Amax)[component],

    u_Amax = run_U(N, depth, k_15, k_13, k_14, u_Amax * (1 + eps))[component]
  )

  (pert - base) / (eps * base + 1e-12)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameter grid (THIS WAS MISSING BEFORE)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
grid <- expand.grid(
  N = N_vals,
  param = params,
  component = components,
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run sensitivity analysis (safe rowwise evaluation)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
df <- grid %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    SI = elasticity(
      N, param, component,
      depth = depth,
      k_15 = k_15,
      k_13 = k_13,
      k_14 = k_14,
      u_Amax = u_Amax
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Scaling
# ------------------------------------------------------------
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    SI_abs = abs(SI),
    SI_scaled = SI / max(SI_abs, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Importance summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------
importance <- df %>%
  group_by(param, component) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abs_SI = mean(abs(SI), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------
param_labels <- c(
  depth  = "Depth",
  k_15   = expression(k[15]~"(half-saturation)"),
  k_13   = expression(k[13]~"(soil scaling)"),
  k_14   = expression(k[14]~"(porosity)"),
  u_Amax = expression(u[max]~"(uptake capacity)")
)

comp_labels <- c(
  U_root = "Root uptake",
  U_myco = "Mycorrhizal uptake"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 1: Elasticity profiles
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(df, aes(x = N, y = SI_scaled, colour = param)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ component, labeller = labeller(component = comp_labels)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    depth  = "#E69F00",
    k_15   = "#56B4E9",
    k_13   = "#009E73",
    k_14   = "#D55E00",
    u_Amax = "#CC79A7"
  ), labels = param_labels) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), oob = scales::squish) +
  labs(
    x = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"),
    y = "Standardised elasticity",
    colour = "Parameter"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 2: Importance ranking
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(importance, aes(param, mean_abs_SI, fill = param)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ component) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean absolute elasticity"
  )
```
